newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung in HK$138 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung in HK$138 mln share issue.

text.p: Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to issue 424 million new shares to controlling shareholder Grandpoint Profits Ltd raising HK$138 million after expenses for additional working capital.

The Chinese medicine retailer said in a statement that Grandpoint Profits Ltd, wholly owned by businessman Louis Lo, would place 270 million existing Tung Fong Hung shares to independent investors at HK$0.328 a share and subscribe to 424 million new shares at the same price net of placing expenses.
Tung Fong Hung shares closed at HK$0.365 on Monday.
The net proceeds of the new share issue would be used for working capital purposes and to enhance Tung Fong Hung's property portfolio, Tung Fong Hung said.

Grandpoint and parties acting in concert with it currently hold 790.78 million or 36.43 percent of the company and after the placement and share subscription would hold about 36.42 percent of the enlarged share capital.
Tai Fook Securities Co Ltd is the agent and underwriter of the placement, Tung Fong Hung said.
